selection: All 136 MGSM items outside the 100-question development subset and all 29 initial-pilot question IDs; 14 pilot IDs fall outside development.
status: Frozen before any of these three instructions are generated on this partition. Restrictive baseline responses already existed and their aggregate results were known.
primary_contrasts: Each new instruction minus the restrictive baseline, paired within model/language. Holm across six model-language comparisons separately for each instruction and each evaluator.
evaluators: Frozen strict whole-suffix numeric scorer; prespecified sensitivity taking the complete first line after the last #### marker, with subsequent text ignored. Numeric content on that line must match the same numeric grammar. Errors and token-limit generations stay missing.
outcomes: Correct/scoreable/requested counts, correct-delivery rate, missingness bounds, paired differences; text before first marker, marker-line syntactic compliance, generation length.
interpretation: Question-partition validation of a post-hoc hypothesis, not external preregistration or a fully unseen benchmark. Clause removal isolates the last restrictive sentence; explicit scope adds one sentence while retaining the restriction.
